map.重心偏移和稳定性怎么算？: How are the centre of gravity offset and the stability calculated?
map.重心偏移=(前脚承重%-50%)×步距，正为前偏、负为后偏；稳定性=100-|实: Offset = (front-foot load % − 50%) × step width, positive meaning forward and negative backward; stability = 100 − |actual load − standard load| × 1.5, so the closer to the standard load the higher it is. The standard front-foot load is about 50% for the horse stance, 65% for the bow stance and 25% for the empty stance.
map.耐力=50+min(40,时长×2)-强度×时长×2。下蹲越深、桩型强度越大、持: Endurance = 50 + min(40, duration × 2) − intensity × duration × 2. The deeper the squat, the greater the intensity of the stance and the longer it is held, the higher the load; the formula is an approximate quantification of training load, meant for comparison rather than as an absolute standard.

map.重心高度 = 身高 × 该桩步高度系数 − 下蹲深度（下限 20cm）: Center-of-gravity height = height × stance height factor − squat depth (minimum 20 cm)
map.姿势强度 = 基础强度 × (下蹲深度 ÷ 30)，上限 1.5: Posture intensity = base intensity × (squat depth ÷ 30), capped at 1.5
map.耐力评分 = 50 + min(40, 时长×2) − 强度 × 时长 × 2（: Endurance score = 50 + min(40, duration×2) − intensity × duration × 2 (clamped to 0–100)
map.稳定性指数 = 100 − |实际承重比 − 标准承重比| × 1.5: Stability index = 100 − |actual load share − standard load share| × 1.5
map.承重偏差 >20% 提示重心偏差较大，建议调整姿势: A load deviation >20% flags a large center-of-gravity shift and suggests adjusting the posture
map.时长 >30s 且强度 >0.8 时提示注意关节保护: When duration >30 s and intensity >0.8, a reminder to protect the joints is shown
